instruction: Use the terminal to create a 640x480 solid white JPEG image named 'canvas.jpeg' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent tried to download kingbird.jpeg from HuggingFace using curl in terminal, but all download attempts failed (0 bytes received, network timeout). Then tried Chrome to navigate to the URL and save the page, but the page never loaded the image. Agent also tried Python urllib but got SSL errors. Never progressed to GIMP compression step.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open terminal, type curl/wget commands with flags, open Chrome and navigate URLs, interact with file save dialogs, switch between terminal and Chrome windows
metadata.failure_analysis: Download from HuggingFace failed due to network connectivity issues in the VM. Model spent all 50 turns trying different download approaches (curl, curl -L, Chrome save-as, Python urllib) but never successfully obtained the image file.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original download+compress task into a simpler local image creation task. Uses ImageMagick convert command (pre-installed) to create an image, testing terminal command execution without network dependency.
metadata.explanation: Task verifies model can use terminal to create a solid white image file with specific dimensions using ImageMagick. Custom getter runs 'identify' to check dimensions and 'convert -resize 1x1 txt:-' to check dominant color. Custom metric gives partial credit: 0.3 for file existence, 0.25 for correct width, 0.25 for correct height, 0.2 for solid white color. [Fixed: added color verification to getter and metric to cover the 'solid white' requirement from instruction]

scoring_breakdown.file_exists: 0.3 - Image file exists at expected path

fix_history: Fix 1: Added color verification to getter using ImageMagick 'convert -resize 1x1 txt:-' to detect dominant color
Fix 2: Added 'is_white' field to getter return dict with fuzzy matching for white (handles 8-bit and 16-bit color spaces)
Fix 3: Added color check in metric with 0.2 partial credit, redistributed weights (0.3 exist + 0.25 width + 0.25 height + 0.2 color)
Fix 4: Added 'color': 'white' to expected rules in evaluator config

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts file existence, dimensions, and dominant color from /home/user/Desktop/canvas.jpeg using ImageMagick identify and convert -resize 1x1 txt:-
Color detection handles both 8-bit (255,255,255) and 16-bit (65535,65535,65535) color spaces with fuzzy matching for near-white values — robust implementation
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('width'), expected.get('height'), expected.get('color') from the rules dict
All instruction requirements are covered: file existence (0.3), correct width 640 (0.25), correct height 480 (0.25), solid white color (0.2) — weights sum to 1.0
JPEG format is implicitly verified by ImageMagick identify succeeding on the file, though not explicitly checked as a separate criterion

Minor: resizing to 1x1 pixel averages all pixels, so a near-white image with minor artifacts could pass the color check — acceptable for this task since the instruction asks to create a solid white image programmatically
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider explicitly checking JPEG format (e.g., via identify output format field) as a minor improvement, though implicit check via file extension and identify success is adequate
